=== CBAM Architecture ===
CBAM(
  (channel_attention): ChannelAttention(
    (shared_mlp): Sequential(
      (0): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
      (1): Linear(in_features=2048, out_features=128, bias=False)
      (2): ReLU(inplace=True)
      (3): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=2048, bias=False)
    )
    (sigmoid): Sigmoid()
  )
  (spatial_attention): SpatialAttention(
    (conv): Conv2d(2, 1, kernel_size=(7, 7), stride=(1, 1), padding=(3, 3), bias=False)
    (sigmoid): Sigmoid()
  )
)

2. Transfer Learning Configuration Comparison¶

In [3]:
import time

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

def quick_train(model, freeze_fn, optimizer_fn, epochs=5, label=''):
    """Quick 5-epoch training for configuration comparison."""
    freeze_fn(model)
    optimizer = optimizer_fn(model)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=epochs)
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler() if DEVICE.type == 'cuda' else None
    es = EarlyStopping(patience=3)
    t0 = time.time()

    for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):
        tr_loss, tr_acc, _ = train_one_epoch(
            model, train_loader, criterion, optimizer, scaler, DEVICE)
        vl_loss, vl_acc, _, _, _ = evaluate(model, val_loader, criterion, DEVICE)
        scheduler.step()
        if es.step(vl_loss, model): break

    es.restore(model)
    _, test_acc, preds, labs, _ = evaluate(model, test_loader, criterion, DEVICE)
    f1 = f1_score(labs, preds, average='macro', zero_division=0)
    elapsed = time.time() - t0

    trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    train_gap = tr_acc - vl_acc
    print(f'  {label}: Acc={test_acc:.4f} F1={f1:.4f} '
          f'Gap={train_gap:.3f} Params={trainable:,} Time={elapsed:.0f}s')
    return test_acc, f1, train_gap, trainable, elapsed

config_results = {}

# Config A: Feature Extraction
set_seed(42)
m_a = CropGuardCNN(num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, dropout=0.4, use_cbam=True, freeze_backbone=True).to(DEVICE)
acc_a, f1_a, gap_a, p_a, t_a = quick_train(
    m_a,
    lambda m: None,  # already frozen
    lambda m: torch.optim.Adam(
        filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, m.parameters()), lr=1e-3),
    label='Config A: Feature Extraction')
config_results['A: Feature Extraction'] = {
    'test_acc': acc_a, 'macro_f1': f1_a, 'gap': gap_a, 'params': p_a, 'time': t_a}

# Config B: Full Fine-Tuning
set_seed(42)
m_b = CropGuardCNN(num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, dropout=0.4, use_cbam=True, freeze_backbone=False).to(DEVICE)
acc_b, f1_b, gap_b, p_b, t_b = quick_train(
    m_b,
    lambda m: None,
    lambda m: torch.optim.Adam(m.parameters(), lr=1e-4),
    label='Config B: Full Fine-Tuning')
config_results['B: Full Fine-Tuning'] = {
    'test_acc': acc_b, 'macro_f1': f1_b, 'gap': gap_b, 'params': p_b, 'time': t_b}

# Config C: Differential LR (selected)
set_seed(42)
m_c = CropGuardCNN(num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, dropout=0.38, use_cbam=True, freeze_backbone=False).to(DEVICE)
m_c.freeze_bottom_n(120)
acc_c, f1_c, gap_c, p_c, t_c = quick_train(
    m_c,
    lambda m: None,
    lambda m: get_differential_optimizer(m, head_lr=7.3e-4, backbone_lr=4.2e-6),
    label='Config C: Differential LR ★')
config_results['C: Differential LR'] = {
    'test_acc': acc_c, 'macro_f1': f1_c, 'gap': gap_c, 'params': p_c, 'time': t_c}

fig.suptitle('Transfer Learning Configuration Comparison', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

keys   = list(config_results.keys())
accs   = [config_results[k]['test_acc'] * 100 for k in keys]
f1s    = [config_results[k]['macro_f1'] for k in keys]
gaps   = [config_results[k]['gap'] * 100 for k in keys]
colors = ['#e74c3c', '#3498db', '#2ecc71']

for ax, vals, title, ylabel in zip(
    axes, [accs, f1s, gaps],
    ['Test Accuracy (%)', 'Macro F1-Score', 'Train-Val Gap (%)'],
    ['Accuracy (%)', 'F1', 'Gap (%)']):
    bars = ax.bar(['A', 'B', 'C★'], vals, color=colors, alpha=0.85)
    for bar, v in zip(bars, vals):
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.01,
                f'{v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_title(title, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(OUT_DIR / 'transfer_learning_comparison.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

3. CBAM Attention Map Visualisation¶

In [6]:
# Load best Phase 3 model
phase3_ckpt = CKPT_DIR / 'cropguard_resnet50_cbam_phase3.pt'
viz_model = CropGuardCNN(
    num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, dropout=0.4,
    use_cbam=True, freeze_backbone=False, head_dims=[512, 256]
).to(DEVICE)

if phase3_ckpt.exists():
    ckpt = torch.load(phase3_ckpt, map_location=DEVICE)
    viz_model.load_state_dict(ckpt['model_state'])
    print(f'Loaded Phase 3 checkpoint.')

viz_model.eval()

# Extract attention maps for one image per class
class_images = get_one_image_per_class(test_loader, NUM_CLASSES)
cam_wrapper  = GradCAMWrapper(viz_model, DEVICE)

n_show  = min(6, len(class_images))
fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, n_show, figsize=(n_show * 3.5, 14))
fig.suptitle('CBAM Attention — Channel + Spatial Maps per Disease Class',
             fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

for col_idx, cls_idx in enumerate(list(class_images.keys())[:n_show]):
    img_t = class_images[cls_idx].to(DEVICE)

    # Register hooks to capture intermediate attention maps
    ch_maps, sp_maps = [], []

    def ch_hook(m, inp, out):
        ch_maps.append(out.detach().cpu())

    def sp_hook(m, inp, out):
        sp_maps.append(out.detach().cpu())

    h1 = viz_model.cbam4.channel_attention.register_forward_hook(ch_hook)
    h2 = viz_model.cbam4.spatial_attention.sigmoid.register_forward_hook(sp_hook)

    with torch.no_grad():
        _ = viz_model(img_t.unsqueeze(0))

    h1.remove(); h2.remove()

    img_np = denormalize(img_t.cpu())
    overlay, heatmap = cam_wrapper.explain(img_t.cpu(), target_class=cls_idx)

    # Channel attention: mean across spatial dims → channel importance bar
    ch_importance = ch_maps[0].squeeze().mean(dim=(-1,-2)).numpy()
    ch_importance = (ch_importance - ch_importance.min()) / (ch_importance.max() - ch_importance.min() + 1e-8)

    # Spatial attention map
    sp_map = sp_maps[0].squeeze().numpy()
    if sp_map.ndim != 2:                            # fallback: mean over channels
        sp_map = sp_map.mean(axis=0)

    axes[0][col_idx].imshow(img_np)
    axes[0][col_idx].set_title(CLASS_DISPLAY[cls_idx], fontsize=7, fontweight='bold')
    axes[0][col_idx].axis('off')

    axes[1][col_idx].bar(range(min(64, len(ch_importance))),
                         ch_importance[:64], color='#3498db', alpha=0.8)
    axes[1][col_idx].set_title('Ch Attention (top-64)', fontsize=7)
    axes[1][col_idx].axis('off') if False else None

    axes[2][col_idx].imshow(sp_map, cmap='hot')
    axes[2][col_idx].set_title('Spatial Attention', fontsize=7)
    axes[2][col_idx].axis('off')

    axes[3][col_idx].imshow(overlay)
    axes[3][col_idx].set_title('Grad-CAM Overlay', fontsize=7)
    axes[3][col_idx].axis('off')

axes[0][0].set_ylabel('Original',   fontsize=9)
axes[1][0].set_ylabel('Ch Attn',    fontsize=9)
axes[2][0].set_ylabel('Sp Attn',    fontsize=9)
axes[3][0].set_ylabel('Grad-CAM',   fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(OUT_DIR / 'cbam_attention_maps.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('CBAM attention maps saved.')

4. First-Layer Filter Visualisation¶

In [7]:
filters = viz_model.layer0[0].weight.data.clone().cpu()  # (64, 3, 7, 7)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(8, 8, figsize=(12, 12))
fig.suptitle('ResNet50 Layer0 — First-layer Filters (64 filters, 7×7, RGB)',
             fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

for ax, filt in zip(axes.flatten(), filters):
    f = filt.permute(1, 2, 0)  # (7, 7, 3)
    f = (f - f.min()) / (f.max() - f.min() + 1e-8)
    ax.imshow(f.numpy()); ax.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(OUT_DIR / 'conv1_filters.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('Gabor-like edge detectors visible in first-layer filters.')
print('These are preserved by differential LR (Config C) and lost with full fine-tuning (Config B).')
